newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury slips after U.S. broker downgrades.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury slips after U.S. broker downgrades.

text.p: Shares in British soft drinks to chocolate group Cadbury Schweppes Plc fell on Tuesday after a downgrade by U.S. broker Oppenheimer had caused the shares to slip in New York overnight.
The shares fell 10p to 592p by 0835 GMT after the stock closed $5/16 lower at $39 in the U.S.
Oppenheimer cut its rating to "market perform" from "buy", based on the stock's current valuation.
Cadbury has outperformed the FTSE All-Share index by seven percent and the FTSE 100 index by two percent so far this year.
